entry.title: The FY26 school surplus: School Committee, 2026-09-09
entry.summary: Unspent school funds returned to the town. A member said the district typically returns roughly this range to the town annually, and returned significantly more two years ago, with this year's return amount still unknown.

entry.title: The FY26 school surplus: Town Meeting, 2026-09-03
entry.summary: questioned the school department's financial management and whether unspent funds would be returned, citing turnover in the finance director role

entry.title: The FY26 school surplus: Finance Committee, 2026-08-27
entry.summary: Asked whether the several 'packages' of money described in the superintendent's presentation were surplus/usable elsewhere or already allocated; wanted clarity on where the money came from.
